data.name: StacksDescription
data.value: A stack lines its items up in one direction, with a gap from the spacing scale, a cross-axis alignment, a distribution along the axis, and a behaviour once a row runs out of room. It has no wrap parameter: a row that must wrap is an OmniRow.

data.name: StacksSettingsDescription
data.value: These settings drive the preview stack.

data.name: StacksOrientationDescription
data.value: Orientation parameter: a column by default.

data.name: StacksGapDescription
data.value: Gap parameter: the space between two items.

data.name: StacksAlignDescription
data.value: Align parameter: position across the axis.

data.name: StacksJustifyDescription
data.value: Justify parameter: position along the axis.

data.name: StacksOverflowDescription
data.value: Overflow parameter, horizontal only: scroll keeps every item at full size, collapse keeps only the icons.

data.name: StacksItemCountDescription
data.value: Enough items to fill the row and trigger the overflow.

data.name: StacksNarrowDescription
data.value: Squeezes the preview frame to test the overflow.

data.name: StacksPreviewHint
data.value: Buttons of three sizes, in a frame taller than they are: alignment and vertical distribution show there.

data.name: StacksAlignsDescription
data.value: The middle block is taller than its neighbours.

data.name: StacksOverflowsDescription
data.value: Five buttons in a frame too narrow for them.

data.name: StacksDividersDescription
data.value: A thin rule between blocks, spaced by the gap of the stack that carries it: horizontal in a column, vertical in a row.

data.name: RowsColumnsDescription
data.value: A row of twelve units and the columns that share it: a span per column, optional spans per breakpoint, and the gap, alignment, distribution and wrapping of the row.

data.name: RowsColumnsRowSettingsDescription
data.value: OmniRow parameters, applied to the preview row.

data.name: RowsColumnsGapDescription
data.value: Gap parameter: the columns deduct it from their width.

data.name: RowsColumnsAlignDescription
data.value: Align parameter: the vertical position of columns of different heights.

data.name: RowsColumnsJustifyDescription
data.value: Justify parameter: where columns that do not fill the twelve units go.

data.name: RowsColumnsWrapDescription
data.value: Wrap parameter, on by default: beyond twelve units, the columns go to the next line.

data.name: RowsColumnsColumnSettingsDescription
data.value: OmniColumn parameters, shared by every column of the preview.

data.name: RowsColumnsSpanDescription
data.value: Span parameter, from 1 to 12, 12 by default: the width at every screen size.

data.name: RowsColumnsResponsiveDescription
data.value: Adds SmallSpan, MediumSpan and LargeSpan, each of which overrides Span from its breakpoint up.

data.name: RowsColumnsPreviewHint
data.value: One column in two is taller, so the alignment of the row shows.

data.name: RowsColumnsSplitsDescription
data.value: Each figure is the Span of a column, out of twelve.

data.name: RowsColumnsAlignsDescription
data.value: The middle column is taller than its neighbours.

data.name: RowsColumnsWrapsDescription
data.value: Three columns of 6, that is eighteen units in a row of twelve.

data.name: RowsColumnsResponsiveExample
data.value: Span 12, SmallSpan 6, MediumSpan 4, LargeSpan 3: one, two, three then four per line as the window widens.

data.name: RowsColumnsGapsDescription
data.value: The spacing scale on an OmniRow, from the tightest to the widest.

data.name: CardsDescription
data.value: A card frames related content in three areas: an optional header, the body and an optional footer. An area that is left out is not drawn at all. A card takes a density of its own and has no variant; an action goes in the footer, as a button.

data.name: CardsSettingsDescription
data.value: These settings drive the preview card.

data.name: CardsHeaderDescription
data.value: Header parameter: left out, the card has no header area at all.

data.name: CardsFooterDescription
data.value: Footer parameter: left out, the card has no footer area at all.

data.name: CardsBorderlessDescription
data.value: A host class sets --omni-card-border-width to 0 around the cards of the preview.

data.name: CardsDiscDescription
data.value: An icon disc and a title in the header, a figure in the body: the surfaces of the mockup, which read the shape of the theme (fill, stroke, radius and shadow).

data.name: CardsDensitiesDescription
data.value: Each card carries its own density, which wins over the page's for everything it holds. The height of the controls, the margins, the check boxes and the switches follow it; a disabled field and a read-only field stay distinct in the three.

data.name: CardsOwnDensityDescription
data.value: In a comfortable page, an alert, a tab strip and a settings tile each carry a density of their own.

data.name: FieldsetsDescription
data.value: A group of fields under a legend: it can be disabled in one go, and fold away as a native disclosure, without script.

data.name: FieldsetsSettingsDescription
data.value: These settings drive the preview group.

data.name: FieldsetsLegendDescription
data.value: Legend parameter: any content, usually a short title.

data.name: FieldsetsDisabledDescription
data.value: Disabled parameter: the browser disables every field of the group.

data.name: FieldsetsCollapsibleDescription
data.value: Collapsible parameter: the legend becomes the handle of a disclosure.

data.name: FieldsetsCollapsedDescription
data.value: Collapsed parameter, for a collapsible group: read at the first render only, the browser handles it afterwards. The preview is rebuilt on each change.

data.name: FieldsetsBoundTitle
data.value: A group whose state is bound

data.name: FieldsetsBoundDescription
data.value: ExpandedChanged reports what the reader does with a collapsible group, so the page can show and remember it. Without it the group loads no script.

data.name: SettingsSectionsDescription
data.value: A settings section is a card with a title and a line of explanation; each setting sits in its own tile, with an optional icon, a name, a description, a control beside it and content under it.

data.name: SettingsSectionsSettingsDescription
data.value: These settings shape the preview section, itself built with the same two components.

data.name: SettingsSectionsTileDescriptionsHint
data.value: Description parameter of OmniSettingsTile, under the name.

data.name: SettingsSectionsFlatHint
data.value: Flat parameter of OmniSettingsSection: no fill and no frame, a hairline between tiles.

data.name: SettingsSectionsContentHint
data.value: ChildContent sits beside the name, Details goes under the row.

data.name: SettingsSectionsGalleryTitle
data.value: A section as found in an application

data.name: SettingsSectionsGalleryDescription
data.value: A section without description, a tile without icon, and a tile with its actions under the row.

data.name: SettingsSectionsClickHint
data.value: A tile holding a switch or a check box toggles on a click anywhere on it: its name labels the control. Clicking the control itself toggles it once.

data.name: AccordionDescription
data.value: Rows whose body unfolds under the header, one at a time or several together. One toggle button per row, usable with the mouse or the keyboard, with the arrows, Home and End between the headers. A free header holds a label, a "?" help, a value and a badge, with no control nested in the button.

data.name: AccordionSettingsDescription
data.value: These settings drive the first accordion of the preview.

data.name: AccordionMultipleDescription
data.value: Multiple parameter: opening a row no longer closes its neighbour.

data.name: AccordionKeepContentDescription
data.value: KeepContent parameter: the body of a row stays rendered once it has been opened.

data.name: AccordionLevelDescription
data.value: Level parameter: the heading that wraps the toggle button of each row.

data.name: AccordionHelpDescription
data.value: Help parameter of a row: a "?" beside the toggle button, never inside it.

data.name: AccordionFirstOpenDescription
data.value: Expanded parameter of the first row. The accordion is rebuilt on each change.

data.name: AccordionPreviewHint
data.value: Arrows, Home and End move between the headers; Enter and Space open a row.

data.name: AccordionAdvancedDescription
data.value: Several rows open together, the body kept, a chosen heading level and a compact density. A control of its own sits beside the toggle button and does not toggle the row.

data.name: PageShellDescription
data.value: The frame of an application page: the layout takes the full width, the header can stay pinned at the top, the body holds the main area, which sets the reading width and stays the landmark that skip links and focus aim at.

data.name: PageShellSettingsDescription
data.value: These settings drive the miniature shell of the preview.

data.name: PageShellContentWidthDescription
data.value: OmniMain ContentWidth parameter: only the content is centred, the header and the sidebar keep the full width.

data.name: PageShellScrollableDescription
data.value: OmniMain Scrollable parameter: the main area scrolls from edge to edge, its scrollbar at the right edge, even when the content is centred.

data.name: PageShellAutoHideDescription
data.value: OmniMain AutoHideScrollbar parameter: the scrollbar keeps its room but stays transparent until the content moves.

data.name: PageShellStickyDescription
data.value: Sticky parameter of OmniHeader: the header stays at the top of the container that scrolls.

data.name: PageShellSurfaceDescription
data.value: Surface parameter of OmniHeader: the colour of the page, or the accent band of the application.

data.name: PageShellFocusTargetDescription
data.value: FocusTarget parameter of OmniMain: tabindex="-1", so that a skip link or a navigation can put the focus on it.

data.name: PageShellLabelledByDescription
data.value: AriaLabelledBy parameter of OmniMain: the id of the heading that names the area.

data.name: PageShellWideCanvasDescription
data.value: Draws the miniature on 100rem, scrolling sideways: in a narrower frame, the three widths look the same.

data.name: PageShellPreviewHint
data.value: Scroll inside the frame: a sticky header stays in place, the dashed outline shows the width of the layout.

data.name: PageShellWidthsDescription
data.value: A main area that scrolls by itself, with each of the three content widths: the scrollbar stays at the right edge of the frame, only the tinted column changes width. Content is the usual choice for an application that centres its reading column.

data.name: PageShellApplicationDescription
data.value: A whole application shell: a top bar with a collapse button, search, help, a bell and the account menu, a side menu that collapses to a rail of icons, and the content. The menu only marks the section chosen.

data.name: PageShellSidebarDescription
data.value: A skip link, a header with the menu toggle and an appearance button, and a side menu that pushes the content. The theme scope keeps a snapshot of its look that a startup script can replay.

data.name: PageShellEndSidebarTitle
data.value: Full width, menu at the end

data.name: PageShellEndSidebarDescription
data.value: The same shell in the other arrangement: full width, the menu at the end, a roomy density, an appearance that follows the system setting and the header drawn as an accent band.

data.name: PageShellRailDescription
data.value: The menu floats over the content, which keeps its width, and leaves a rail of icons once closed; a click on the veil closes it.

data.name: PageShellTabsDescription
data.value: Tabs in a frame of fixed height: only the selected panel scrolls (ScrollablePanels), and a wheel turn anywhere in the frame, the tab strip included, scrolls it (WheelScrollScope).

data.name: DetailsDescription
data.value: The page of one record: a header with back button, title, badges, actions and menu, the loading, found and not-found states, labelled values in columns, relative time and empty states.

data.name: DetailsSettingsDescription
data.value: These settings drive the detail page of the preview.

data.name: DetailsStateDescription
data.value: State parameter of OmniDetailShell: the header is painted at once, the content waits for the record.

data.name: DetailsBackVariantDescription
data.value: BackVariant parameter of OmniPageHeader: the back arrow in the accent colour, or discreet.

data.name: DetailsFramedDescription
data.value: Framed parameter of OmniPageHeader: brings back the bordered block; by default the header sits on the page.

data.name: DetailsPinnedDescription
data.value: Narrow the window under 40rem: the pinned button is never folded behind "Show more", it takes a line under the title row, and the menu stays at the end of that row.

data.name: StatTilesDescription
data.value: A figure on the card surface: tinted icon, value, title and an optional detail line; clickable, the whole tile becomes a button. Tiles of facts and tile grids complete the family.

data.name: StatTilesSettingsDescription
data.value: Each setting drives the tile of the live preview.

data.name: StatTilesValueDescription
data.value: The figure itself, already formatted by the page.

data.name: StatTilesDetailDescription
data.value: A muted line under the title: a trend, a reset time.

data.name: StatTilesIconDescription
data.value: A decorative icon on a tinted square before the text.

data.name: StatTilesClickableDescription
data.value: OnClick makes the whole tile one button, named by its title and value.

data.name: StatTilesWrapDescription
data.value: With WrapTitle the caption wraps at its normal size instead of shrinking and being cut. The first tile wraps, the second keeps the caption on one line, and the three tiles of the grid keep the same height.

data.name: StatTilesColumnsDescription
data.value: The second tile is clickable. The title of a tile stays on one line: smaller when it does not fit, then cut with an ellipsis, its whole text in the tooltip (third tile, narrowed to a small column).

data.name: StatTilesFactsDescription
data.value: A title, then rows of icon, term and value on three columns shared by the tiles of the grid, so they line up. A value too long is cut with an ellipsis and read whole in the tooltip. The first tile carries linked values, the second a badge, the third is a single link.

data.name: StatTilesFactsNarrowDescription
data.value: Four tiles on one row: each row decides on its own whether the term and the value share a line or the value goes under the term.

data.name: StatTilesGridDescription
data.value: All the tiles of the package have the same width and, by default, the same height, whatever their content; DoubleWidth spreads one over two columns, and a clickable card or a linked stat tile keeps its place.

data.name: StatTilesNaturalDescription
data.value: EqualHeights set to false: each tile keeps the height of its content, aligned to the top of its row; the widths do not change.

data.name: StatTilesUniformDescription
data.value: UniformSize: about the same width, exactly the same height, whatever the content (a stat tile, a fact tile, a double-width navigation tile and a card).

data.name: NavTilesDescription
data.value: A navigation tile, the home of an administration area or a hub of sections: an icon on a tinted square, a title and an optional description, the whole tile one link. Hovered, only its shadow changes.

data.name: NavTilesSettingsDescription
data.value: Each setting drives the preview tiles live.

data.name: NavTilesToneDescription
data.value: Tone parameter: the colour of the square and its icon, Accent by default.

data.name: NavTilesShowDescriptionHint
data.value: Description parameter: a muted line under the title, what is found there.

data.name: NavTilesFitTitleHint
data.value: The title shrinks to stay on one line instead of wrapping.

data.name: NavTilesDisabledHint
data.value: Disabled: the last tile has no link, cannot take focus, is announced as unavailable and is attenuated, at the same size.

data.name: NavTilesGridTitle
data.value: Double-width tile in a fluid grid

data.name: NavTilesGridDescription
data.value: MinColumnWidth: the column count follows the width of the grid itself, not the window's. Beside a side menu the grid has fewer, wider columns; a DoubleWidth tile takes two columns where the grid has two, one otherwise.

data.name: CardsSurfacesDescription
data.value: An account menu on the layer of floating surfaces, tabs, a side menu whose current item is marked by its fill and text weight, a link and a tooltip. Cards and menus read the shape of the theme (fill, stroke, radius and shadow).
